h1: Cross Pattaya Pratamnak — Colonial Boutique Design with Ocean-view Rooms on Pratamnak Hill
intro: Picture a white colonial-style building perched on Pratamnak Hill: you open your room door onto a private balcony and the Gulf of Pattaya stretches out in front of you, in a neighbourhood far quieter than the downtown strip — Cross Pattaya Pratamnak is the boutique design hotel that opened in 2022 and quickly climbed to become one of Pattaya's highest-rated stays · 78 modern-colonial rooms, with ocean-view rooms featuring private balconies, a saltwater pool, Moon Spa and a beach club · from approx. ฿2,500/night · scoring 9.4 from 352 reviews on Trip.com

body.html: Cross Pattaya Pratamnak opened in 2022 on Pratamnak Hill, an upscale pocket between Pattaya Beach and Jomtien Beach in the south of the city — a location far quieter and more private than downtown, yet only minutes by car from the beaches and nightlife · The building is white colonial design with clean modern lines, looking refined from the entrance · This is what guests mention most: it feels like a deliberately designed boutique, not a generic square block of a hotel.

The 78 rooms start with the Urban Room at around 27 sqm and run up through Luxury Ocean View, Family Room and several suites · Ocean-view rooms all have private balconies looking out over the Gulf of Pattaya, and many reviewers say sipping coffee in the morning or watching the sunset from the balcony was their favourite part · The decor is warm and modern, beds are comfortable and the bathrooms are well designed · One honest note from real reviews: in-room storage is fairly limited — small wardrobes and bedside tables — so anyone travelling with a lot of luggage may find it a little tight.
"Stepped onto the balcony in the morning to a quiet Gulf of Pattaya — no traffic, no nightlife noise, real rest — then a ten-minute Grab down to the beach."

The heart of the hotel is the saltwater pool set among the white buildings, which feels like a private courtyard · Around it are loungers and seating areas, with an atmosphere noticeably calmer than downtown hotel pools · Beyond the pool there's Moon Spa, using PAÑPURI products, the Cloud Club fitness centre, and a beach club for sitting by the water · One small note from reviews: parts of the pool edge can be slippery getting in and out, so watch your step.

Breakfast draws particular praise · It's served à la carte plus a small buffet, and comes with complimentary sparkling wine — a little detail many guests said made the stay feel special · The food is freshly prepared and tasty, with enough variety for a 78-room property · There's an in-house restaurant and bar, but because the hotel sits on Pratamnak Hill, dining options in the immediate area are fewer than in central Pattaya, so if you want lots of restaurant choice nearby you'll need a short ride down.

Location is both the selling point and the trade-off · Pratamnak Hill is quiet and private, about 5–10 minutes by car from Jomtien and Pattaya beaches and 10–15 minutes from Walking Street — ideal for travellers who want to escape the chaos without going too far · The trade-off is that little is walkable, so you'll rely on Grab or songthaew · Another point from real reviews is that room soundproofing isn't as strong as it could be — some guests heard noise from neighbouring rooms or the corridor — so light sleepers may want to request a corner or quieter floor.

Honestly, Cross Pattaya Pratamnak suits couples and anyone wanting a beautifully designed hotel in a calm setting, at a price more attainable than a 5-star beachfront resort · Rates start around ฿2,500/night on low-season weekdays, rising to ฿3,500–4,500+ on weekends and in high season, with ocean-view suites going higher · If you want to walk to the beach and nightlife, this isn't it — but if you want to wake up to a quiet ocean view from your own balcony, in a hotel that's genuinely well designed, Cross Pattaya Pratamnak is the best fit in this neighbourhood.

A tip from following the reviews here: request an Ocean View room facing directly out over the bay — the sea view from the balcony is what guests love most, while the cheaper Urban Room doesn't get the same standout view · Booking direct with the hotel earns a 10% member discount and free kids' breakfast, but booking through a platform is more flexible if you want to compare prices and keep free cancellation.

honestSummary: Cross Pattaya Pratamnak is the boutique design hotel that fits best for couples and anyone wanting a beautiful hotel in a calm setting, at a price more attainable than a beachfront resort — modern-colonial design, ocean-view rooms with balconies, a saltwater pool and spa on Pratamnak Hill · The trade-offs: it's not walkable to the beach or nightlife so you rely on rides, and room soundproofing isn't as strong as it could be.
honestChecks: If you want to walk to the beach and nightlife — this is up on Pratamnak Hill, a 5–15 minute ride down → consider Hilton or Wave in central Pattaya, walkable to everything
If you're a light sleeper sensitive to noise — real reviews note soundproofing isn't great → request a corner room or quieter floor and avoid rooms by the corridor

If you want a full beachfront resort with a wide private beach — this is a boutique on the hill with a small beach club, not an expansive private beach → consider InterContinental or Veranda Na Jomtien instead

faq.q: Where is Cross Pattaya Pratamnak and what's nearby?
faq.a: Cross Pattaya Pratamnak sits on Pratamnak Hill, an upscale residential pocket in the south of Pattaya · It's about 5–10 minutes by car from Jomtien and Pattaya beaches, 10–15 minutes from Walking Street, and near the Pattaya Big Buddha · U-Tapao Airport (UTP) is about 35 minutes away · The area is quiet and private, but little is walkable so you'll rely on Grab or songthaew.

faq.q: How much does Cross Pattaya Pratamnak cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start around ฿2,500/night for an Urban Room on low-season weekdays, rising to ฿3,500–4,500+ on weekends and in high season · Options range from the Urban Room and Luxury Ocean View to the Family Room and suites such as the Elite Executive Ocean Suite · Always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Do all rooms at Cross Pattaya Pratamnak have ocean views?
faq.a: Not all of them · The Luxury Ocean View rooms and the Ocean suites face the Gulf of Pattaya with private balconies, while the cheaper Urban Room doesn't get the same standout sea view · If you want an ocean view from the balcony, book an Ocean View room from the start.

faq.q: Who is Cross Pattaya Pratamnak best for?
faq.a: It suits couples and anyone wanting a beautifully designed hotel in a calm setting, at a price more attainable than a beachfront resort · If you want to walk to the beach and nightlife, look at Hilton or Wave in central Pattaya · For a full private-beach resort, consider InterContinental or Veranda Na Jomtien.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Cross Pattaya Pratamnak?
faq.a: Breakfast is served à la carte plus a small buffet, with complimentary sparkling wine · It draws a lot of praise in reviews for both taste and setting · Some packages include breakfast, so check at the time of booking.

faq.q: Is Cross Pattaya Pratamnak well soundproofed?
faq.a: From real reviews, room soundproofing isn't as strong as it could be — some guests hear noise from neighbouring rooms or the corridor · If you're a light sleeper, request a corner room or quieter floor and avoid rooms by the corridor and lift when booking.
